advisory_dispositions.justification: The affected parser is absent from the published site and is reachable only while Docusaurus measures repository-local images during a static build. The dependency security preflight rejects ICNS assets by extension and file signature before every supported docs build entry point. There is no request-time image parsing or user-upload path.
review_when: image-size publishes a version newer than 2.0.2
Docusaurus changes the image-size dependency or image processing path
the site adds runtime or user-supplied image processing
